blocks.text: Recognizes the first cohort that helped start the Cyber Pet world. Characters first uploaded on or before November 14, 2026 are Foundlings, including board-only uploads. The cohort is Quarter 1 of school year 2026–2027. Preserve an exact upload date when known; otherwise display the school term without inventing a date.
Placement: Character profile sheet, beside Character Profile and Care.
Reward: Commemorative only; no XP, currency or stat bonus.

Animation: 56 frames at 10 fps (5.6 seconds). Inner rings rotate counterclockwise / clockwise / counterclockwise. Ribbons share a wave anchored at the mount; the long center tail remains fully visible. Reduced motion holds the first frame.
Hover: “founding ribbon for starting the world”. Same approved artwork in two placements. No decoration on character browsing.
